selection: Four public development cases across four tradeoff classes. P06/P11 are R7 design-exposed regression probes; P05/P10 were not used for this R7 design but have historical public exposure. No result-based exclusion, fresh/holdout claim, human calibration or majority-scenario inference.
candidate_hypothesis: Selecting one advertised original R0/Q question ID and displayed basis references per judgment row, then rebuilding complete original sentence coordinates at runtime, may reduce format/binding losses and improve evidence-backed answers to original questions or subquestions across at least two tradeoff classes. Bound references alone do not prove source applicability, answer usefulness or constraint satisfaction.
candidate_scope: R7 retains R6 source views, the existing two-stage calls and five-fact/evidence/citation/self-review limits. The second judgment model selects one original question_id plus displayed basis_refs; runtime supplies canonical whole-sentence coordinates. Original C constraints remain in the prompt and self-review, but individual rows do not claim coverage of every C. No new source, call or authority.
falsifiers: Rows remain absent or materially wrong despite eligible displayed question and basis references; structural binding gains alone are not answer gains.
Selected references omit decisive qualifiers, cite an inapplicable version/workload/mode, or support a premise without supporting the conclusion.
The report or self-review drops useful bound analysis, or treats one selected question as proof that all original constraints were satisfied.

Fewer than two distinct tradeoff classes gain evidence-backed answers to original questions or subquestions; gains only in design-exposed cases still count for development screening but cannot establish transfer.
A new critical factual/safety error or material regression of an already passing case occurs.

assessment.pass: Whole-report usable-and-supported is recorded separately: all five maintained content checks pass and no critical error; unresolved disagreement cannot pass.
assessment.comparison: Development net benefit requires evidence-backed improvement in an original question or original subquestion in at least two different tradeoff classes, with no new critical error or material regression of an already passing case. Two whole-report passes are not an added gate. Syntax-valid rows, more bound quotes, lexical citation status, length or cost alone are not content gains.
assessment.severity: Critical: decision-changing fabricated capability/source/measurement, causal or applicability reversal, hard-constraint violation, unsupported decisive exclusion/guarantee or unsafe operation. Important gap: user cannot understand the current choice or next test. Minor formatting or repetition alone does not fail. A useful conditional choice need not name one winner or complete a deployment/recovery exercise.
assessment.review: Independent read-only assistant review; lock request, report and saved-source content judgments before examining Trace/cost where possible. Record exposure, unresolved disagreements and assistant-only limitations; no human calibration.
assessment.source_policy: Use only originally saved cited passages and their captured versions/conditions to judge decisive report claims. Original reference URLs and historical reference-audit entries are review pointers, never injected request/seed material or proof of current truth. New review material cannot repair missing original evidence. Unreachable, insufficiently scoped and cross-language uncertain evidence remains unknown.
assessment.question_and_constraint_policy: Score each original question/subquestion against the request and saved support. A row bound to R0/Q does not by itself establish the answer, semantic applicability or any individual C constraint; assess all original constraints at report level and through self-review. Do not demand row-wise C coverage.
measurements: supported answer changes to original R0 and Q questions, with decision relevance
saved-source sentence completeness, scope and applicability through judgment/binding/citation/review/report
all original constraints, conditional advice, uncertainty, critical errors and important gaps
whole-report usable-and-supported separately from partial answer gains
calls, tokens, active/wall time and unknown usage after content judgments
assessment.holdout_scope: All four cases are public and historically exposed development material. Parent P10/P11 holdout labels are provenance only. Unexposed transfer and stable quality require separately held cases and runs.

忽略分区对顺序的影响
